A '''crime lord''' hired a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Unidentified bounty hunter (Sudden Restoration attack)|bounty hunter]] to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] an [[Unidentified Imperial officer (Sudden Restoration patient)|Imperial officer]] who was receiving medical treatment aboard the [[Carosite]] [[Hospital ship/Legends|medical ship]] ''[[Sudden Restoration]]'' during the days of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. The attack prompted the New Republic to station [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing fighters]] aboard the ship to prevent future attacks.
